SQL:
SELECT
  customers.region_id AS "orders.customers.region_id",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
WHERE
  orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  customers.region_id
LIMIT 21
